goal: Live QA 2026-11-02: a failed Astrology AI reading used up the only daily turn while the app said the question was kept for a retry; count only delivered readings (completed or later deleted) against the daily limit, with at most 2 extra failed attempts per day to bound cost. Also finish the Vietnamese copy pass on Astrology (Journal, Astrology AI, AI provider) per analysis TA-10/JO-07, and continue UI items TA-08 and JO-05 from the 2026-10-30 analysis. JO-05 lines from PR #14 read {id, reversed, spread} while synced readings store {cardId, orientation, positionLabel}, so nothing showed for real entries; one parser now reads both.
successCriteria: ai-astrology-insight returns daily_limit_reached only after a delivered reading or after the failed-attempt allowance is spent.
Vietnamese Astrology and Journal strings use Nhật ký, Chiêm tinh and AI Chiêm tinh; the copy test bans the old phrases.
Mobile typecheck, Jest and backend contract checks pass.
TA-08: each card in a Tarot result says whether its paragraph is the reading for this question (Vì sao lá này ở vị trí …) or the general card meaning.
JO-05: a saved Tarot reading in the Journal shows a row of small card images, reversed cards turned, each labelled with position, name and orientation.
Journal and Home toasts no longer say insight, cloud or Share-card in Vietnamese.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL or migration; deploying ai-astrology-insight waits for Owner approval.
English copy and persona data are unchanged.
